messages:
Li (support): hitting you all — multiple customer reports of high 502/504s and 'TLS handshake timeout' errors for hosted inference in eu-west since ~09:42 UTC. Customers seeing spikes when uploading prompts (large payloads). Escalating to war room.
ops-bot: alert triggered: gateway.tls.handshake.timeout rate > 1.5% (5m) in eu-west; sample trace ids: trace-6a1f, trace-6a2b
Zoe (oncall): on it. initial check: no deploys in last 2 hours per deploy-bot. rolling through logs now.
Arjun (infra): can you confirm if cert rotation ran overnight or if LB changed?
Matt (eng-runtime): I saw a small uptick in connection resets from the proxy->edge pool earlier, could be keepalive scoring out.
Zoe (oncall): quick repro: from a eu-west pod I ran: `curl -v --http2 https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d @sample.json` and got `* TLS handshake timeout` after 15s. repeated 3/5.
Li (support): customers include AcmeGames and FinCo — both reported retries and timeouts at the same window. shipping Cc to Evan for customer comms.
Evan (acct-mgr): noted, will prepare a status blurb once we have mitigation plan.
Matt (eng-runtime): sharing recent logs snippet: ```
2026-03-17T09:42:12Z gateway proxy=nginx edge_conn=reset tls_err="timeout" trace=trace-6a1f
2026-03-17T09:42:15Z backend pop=kp-03 conn_count=96 wait_ms=1200
2026-03-17T09:42:16Z kvcache miss key=prefix:abc latency_ms=5
```
Arjun (infra): infra checks: LB nodes healthy, cert expiry not in window (expires 2026-05). However, we see spike of ESTABLISHED->CLOSE_WAIT on the proxy side. Could be client-side half-closed sockets and then proxy hitting handshake deadline.
Zoe (oncall): immediate mitigation suggestion: temporarily increase TLS handshake timeout on gateway from 15s -> 30s for eu-west, and ramp keepalive_timeout to 75s to avoid stomping connections. Also enable fallback routing to eu-central for new requests.
Matt (eng-runtime): +1 for TLS timeout bump. Also we should temporarily reduce max concurrent upstream conns per proxy worker to lower head-of-line blocking. I'll push a canary config to 10% of frontends.
Arjun (infra): rolling the TLS timeout + keepalive now to canary group (10% eu-west). deploy-bot: rolling config canary -> 10% cluster eu-west at 09:55 UTC.
deploy-bot: canary applied to 2/20 frontends (eu-west). monitoring for error rate.
Zoe (oncall): watching metrics dashboard: initial drop in TLS timeout rate in canary from 2.0% -> 0.6% within 2 mins. promising.
Li (support): telling customers we have a mitigation and are doing a staged config change. ETA for full rollout?
Arjun (infra): if canary stays stable for 5m we'll do 50% -> full rollout in 15m.
Matt (eng-runtime): creating action item: investigate client-side connection churn, add more verbose telemetry on handshake durations and SNI mismatch. Also audit proxy worker memory / fd usage.
Zoe (oncall): confirmed canary passed 10m baseline — proceeding with 50% now.
deploy-bot: canary expanded -> 50% at 10:10 UTC, full rollout queued.
Zoe (oncall): full rollout complete 10:22 UTC. Error rate returned to baseline ~0.1% by 10:28.
Evan (acct-mgr): sent customer update at 10:35 UTC: short blip, mitigation applied, follow-up postmortem promised.
Li (support): closing current page for customers, will await postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Zoe (oncall): POST-INCIDENT ACTION ITEMS:
- (Arjun) add alert refinement: split tls.handshake.timeouts by stage (client_hello vs cert_verify) and region — due 2026-03-20.
- (Matt) instrument handshake timing histogram + SNI/ALPN labels and add a debug flag for verbose TLS traces — due 2026-03-19.
- (Infra) increase frontend fd soft-limits and audit connection reuse patterns; run load repro with large payloads — due 2026-03-21.
- (Support/Evan) craft customer postmortem and outreach; include timeline and mitigation steps — due 2026-03-18.
- (All) schedule a blameless postmortem meeting (30m) and attach logs/traces; meeting scheduled 2026-03-18 15:00 UTC in #incidents.
Matt (eng-runtime): quick note: possible long-term fix = smarter proxy backpressure + prefix caching for uploads to avoid long-lived TLS handshakes under burst. raising RFC.
Arjun (infra): will run a full repro test from multiple AZs tomorrow morning.
Zoe (oncall): thanks team — marking incident as 'mitigated' and will own the postmortem doc. Closing thread here.
